definitions: A formal assessment of something with the intention of instituting change if necessary.
A critical appraisal of a book, play, film, etc., published in a newspaper or magazine.
A second or further careful consideration of something.
A ceremonial inspection of military forces.
examples: The company conducted a review of its safety procedures.
The film received a positive review.
The court ordered a judicial review of the decision.
The Queen attended the annual military review.
